description: Adds up the calories and macros of foods from food_search (by id) in grams or portions, item by item and in total. For packaged food, pass its values per 100 g from food_barcode as a custom item.

portions.description: Of the food’s usual portion (default 1 when grams is missing)

language.description: Language of food and recipe names; default en

name: meal_nutrition
title: Nutrition of a meal
